details:
- rebuild with newer golang version 1.22.9-1.el9_2.tuxcare.els26 to fix the
  following Go standard-library CVE's tracked for this package
  - CVE-2026-33818: fix encoding/asn1 stack exhaustion by enforcing a recursion
    depth limit in Unmarshal when parsing deeply nested structures
  - CVE-2026-56858: fix html/template XSS where pathological input could close an
    unescaped '/' early and inject attacker-controlled content
  - CVE-2026-56860: fix net/url quadratic complexity when resolving relative paths
    containing many '..' parent-directory segments
  - CVE-2026-56862: fix crypto/tls denial of service from post-handshake KeyUpdate
    messages forcing unbounded key-derivation work
- the same golang rebuild also carries CVE-2026-56859 (encoding/xml unmarshal
  depth-limit bypass via a custom UnmarshalXML), which is not tracked by these
  tickets
